conservation_status.note_en: The current species-level global category checked for this review is Near Threatened; local or legal categories may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 本次复核确认的当前物种级全球等级为近危；地方或法律等级可能不同。

description.en: Capable of producing some of the loudest bird calls in the world, the male is easily recognized by the strange black 'beard' of fleshy wattles hanging from its throat.
description.zh: 这种鸟能发出世界上最响亮的鸟鸣声之一。雄鸟非常容易辨认，其喉部悬挂着垂成奇特黑色「胡须」状的肉质垂饰。

anatomy.en: The male bearded bellbird is striking with white plumage on its body and brown on its head and wings. Its most bizarre feature is the large number of stringy black wattles—often numbering over 30—that hang from its throat, resembling a messy beard. These wattles are not feathers but fleshy extensions that can be inflated or moved. Females are much more cryptic, featuring olive-green plumage with yellow streaks, blending perfectly with forest foliage.
anatomy.zh: 雄性须钟伞鸟特征鲜明，身体为白色羽毛，头和翅膀为棕色。其最奇特的特征是喉部长有大量线状黑色肉垂——通常超过30条——垂下如同凌乱的胡须。这些肉垂并非羽毛，而是可以膨胀或移动的肉质突起。雌鸟则隐蔽得多，拥有橄榄绿色的羽毛并带有黄色条纹，能完美融入森林枝叶中。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This review classifies the species as frugivore. Feeding, social behavior and activity can vary with age, season and locality, so details are tied to the cited species account rather than generalized from one observation.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 本次复核把该物种归为食果性。取食、社会行为和活动会随年龄、季节与地点变化，因此细节应对应所引物种资料，不能从一次观察泛化。

habitat_and_distribution.en: They inhabit humid tropical forests and montane woodlands in northern South America, with populations found in Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, and northern Brazil, as well as the island of Trinidad. They move seasonally through the forest canopy, following the ripening schedules of their favorite fruiting trees.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 它们栖息在南美洲北部的湿润热带森林和山地林地中，种群分布于哥伦比亚、委内瑞拉、圭亚那、巴西北部以及特立尼达岛。它们会随季节在森林冠层中移动，追随它们喜爱的果类树木的成熟期。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and every polygon coordinate are retained exactly. The polygon remains labelled approximate because reusable authoritative boundary geometry was not established in this review.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放级别和每个多边形坐标均完全保留。由于本次复核未取得可复用的权威边界几何，该多边形继续标为近似范围。

content_review.notes: Taxonomy, current global status, legacy bilingual sections, image identity criteria and unchanged habitat geometry reviewed for legacy QC batch 03B–03E.

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Breeding includes egg laying, incubation and a dependent nestling period. Nest type, clutch size and seasonal timing must be interpreted for the population and latitude cited by the source.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 繁殖包括产卵、孵化和雏鸟依赖期。巢型、窝卵数和季节时间必须结合来源所指的种群与纬度解释。

threats.en: The Near Threatened global category does not remove local risks from habitat change, direct mortality, disturbance, pollution or climate effects; the relevant combination differs across the range.
threats.zh: 近危这一全球等级并不排除生境变化、直接死亡、干扰、污染或气候影响等地方风险；不同分布区的风险组合不同。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality, and update management when population monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威所确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在种群监测或分类变化时更新管理。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes may share color or body shape. Confirm records with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked source rather than a filename or single feature.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享颜色或体形。记录应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元来源确认，不能只凭文件名或单一特征。

communication_and_senses.en: The species uses the sensory channels available to its class—vision, sound, chemical cues, touch or vibration—in combinations shaped by its habitat. The cited species account should be used before assigning a specific call or signal.
communication_and_senses.zh: 该物种会组合使用其类群具备的视觉、声音、化学信号、触觉或振动等感官通道，具体组合受生境塑造。指定某种叫声或信号前，应查阅所引物种资料。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population must not be presented as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、迁移、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。不能把某一种群的日期写成全球统一规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback, nest or den disturbance, and any approach that changes natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放叫声、干扰巢穴或洞穴，以及任何改变自然行为的接近。

evolution.en: Procnias averano is placed in Procnias, family Cotingidae, order Passeriformes. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy source.
evolution.zh: Procnias averano归入钟伞鸟属、伞鸟科、雀形目。本次复核遵循分类来源所引的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs may narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Fresh sign near a dangerous or sensitive animal requires distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。危险或敏感动物附近的新鲜痕迹意味着应保持距离。

text.en: Its accepted scientific name in this review is Procnias averano.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Procnias averano。

text.en: Near Threatened is the checked global IUCN category, not a regional legal status.
text.zh: 近危是本次核对的全球IUCN等级，并非地区性法律等级。

text.zh: 地图保留原有近似范围几何，并不声称这是新核实的边界。
